data.one_liner: Utility for generating and populating dart-define configuration files
data.what_it_does: Generates Dart code and JSON configuration files for compile-time variables and flavors using pubspec.yaml configurations and environment variables.
use_when: You need a structured way to handle secrets and compile-time variables across local development and CI/CD pipelines.
You want to generate Dart configuration classes and JSON files for Flutter's --dart-define-from-file option.
avoid_when: You prefer managing your environment variables and launch arguments manually.
You are not using compile-time variables or flavors in your Flutter application.
strengths: Integrates smoothly with CI/CD pipelines by reading from system environment variables.
Validates required configuration variables to prevent missing value runtime errors.
Supports multiple flavors and custom output paths.
weaknesses: Requires CLI tool activation or adding as a dev dependency.
Must be careful with caching in CI/CD environments requiring the --force flag.
data.setup_notes: Activate the CLI tool globally or add as a dev dependency, then define variables in pubspec.yaml.
